headline: Thai Auto Exports Drop 34% in October Following Severe Floods
summary: Thailand's vehicle exports fell 34% year-on-year to 54,503 units in October due to lower internal combustion engine vehicle output after heavy flooding hit key manufacturing provinces.
why: Thailand is Southeast Asia's principal automotive production and export hub, supplying vehicles and parts across regional and global markets.

impacts.name: Automotive Sector
impacts.why: Production stoppages caused by natural flooding sharply reduced vehicle export volumes.
